r: **First Indian woman member of a Legislative Council** (Madras, nominated 1926, sat 1927) – India's first woman legislator; anti-Devadasi bill (1928)
Andhra Mahila Sabha (1937); first chair, Central Social Welfare Board (1953)
Started by CM **Chandrababu Naidu**; run by **SERP**; built **women's self-help groups**
Velugu renamed; DWCRA and Velugu work integrated
Journals **Janana** and **Satihita Bodhini**; women's education and **widow remarriage**
**1919 Machilipatnam** Adi-Andhra conference demanded abolition of the **Jogini and Devadasi** systems
Grew out of **Aksharajyothi** literacy classes; arrack prohibited from **1 October 1993**
Hindu Succession (AP Amendment) Act: daughters get coparcenary rights (Central amendment 2005)
73rd / 74th Amendments: one-third seats – Art. 243D(3) Panchayats, 243T Municipalities

3.x: The Constitution (**131st**) Amendment Bill, 2026 sought faster women's reservation by redistributing Lok Sabha seats; it was **defeated in April 2026**.
